verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents backend features (Payload database, auth, file storage, Supabase connection) and secure storage of a key the user supplies. Nothing shows built-in LLM calls or agents for the generated app, or managed provider access that removes the need for the user's own keys. Storing a user-provided secret is an adjacent control and does not deliver keyless AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself
